**Landed** — layout-gate: commit `a3248c70` on `michael/dev`.

- Every `<a>` now gets the house link style (ink + underline), not just ones in prose — the "$1,128 of AI work" style bug (blue, browser-default links) is fixed sitewide; nav/sidebar/tabs unaffected.
- `Server/smoke.mjs` now fails the merge gate on two new layout bugs: text sitting flush against an unpadded edge, and anything painted above a page's title — proven against a reverted repro of the real bug, a synthetic fixture, and a 60-page false-positive sweep.
- One line added to `Server/doc/review.md` pointing at both checks.

Full report, proof screenshot and build log: [layout-gate task](/framework/ai/2026-10-03/layout-gate/). One known, logged (not fixed) gap: Doc-shelled/tabbed pages' title lives outside the checked scope, matching the existing link-checker's own scope — a follow-up if wanted, not blocking.
Still working through its careful read-before-write phase. I'll wait for its completion notification rather than poll further.

Landed. Here's the summary:

**Cards: a sub-card opens in a column beside its parent** — landed on `michael/dev`, live now.

- A sub-card opens beside its parent in two **equal** columns (not a takeover).
- Drilling deeper slides the window: the last two levels always show, earlier ones collapse into a padded breadcrumb — exactly the owner's "as deep as it goes" ask.
- Card template cleanup: header shows status only while something's running, Actions + type/status/cost/tags/who-worked-on-it/files moved into a quiet read-only sidebar, the per-card chat column is gone (talking happens in the one global drawer).
- Found and fixed the actual bug that made the brief's own "Now" card example not work: its `page.jsonl` used core's generic `content` list feature, which was silently replacing `Card`'s render method outright — the same trap class CLAUDE.md documents for `render`.

Mid-task I discovered another session's minion had already built the hard part (the N-deep breadcrumb/sliding-window) in a leftover worktree while I was building the 2-level case — merged both by hand rather than duplicate the work, verified the combined result against the real Now card at 1200/1920/2560/3440, zero new console errors.

Landing hit real shared-main-tree contention (another agent's commit landed on my branch, the main tree got stuck off `michael/dev`) — resolved without losing anyone's work (rescue branch + a note left for that task), landed via `merge.mjs --main`, confirmed live on `monorepo.localhost`.

Left open: no drawer-open screenshot (only drawer-closed, at all four widths), and 3+ level chains are proven only on a throwaway test case, not real data.

All work done and committed in the worktree (2 commits). Still blocked on the main repo returning to `michael/dev` to run the merge — not mine to force. No change of plan; will retry `Server/merge.mjs` as soon as that branch frees up.
